about: Country cards for lives born in Vietnam. Each card is dealt only to them (and a little more often than general cards). Sources are in each card's "src".

events.src: ===================== Vietnam (VN) ===================== Hụi / họ: legal under Decree 19/2019 if interest stays within 20% a year; organisers sometimes collapse ("vỡ hụi") (Thư viện Pháp luật; PLO). Risk ESTIMATE.

en..x: Your neighbours run a hụi (họ): everyone pays in each month and members bid to take the pot early. It is legal if interest stays within 20% a year, but sometimes the organiser can’t pay (“vỡ hụi”).

zh..x: 邻居们办了一个标会（hụi，也叫họ）：大家每月交钱，想早点拿钱的人出价竞标。只要利息不超过每年20%就是合法的，但有时会首付不出钱（“倒会”）。

zht..x: 鄰居們辦了一個標會（hụi，也叫họ）：大家每月交錢，想早點拿錢的人出價競標。只要利息不超過每年20%就是合法的，但有時會頭期款不出錢（「倒會」）。

events.src: Working in Japan: about 200,000 Vietnamese technical interns by June 2025, the largest group (Vietnamese government, via Bao Bac Ninh; MHLW); jobs in Japan cost workers about 192 million dong (≈ US$8,000) on average, though the legal cap is US$3,600 (ILO; IOM study). At market exchange rates that is ≈ 3.8 years of the game's typical wage; pay and costs in Japan are ESTIMATES.

en..x: An agency offers a three-year traineeship in Japan at about {a} a year. About 200,000 Vietnamese are technical interns there, the largest group. Fees average about US$8,000, often borrowed, although the legal cap is US$3,600.

zh..x: 一家中介给你一份去日本的三年实习合约，年薪约{a}。约有20万越南人在日本当技能实习生，是人数最多的群体。中介费平均约8,000美元，常常要借钱，虽然法定上限是3,600美元。

zht..x: 一家中介給你一份去日本的三年實習合約，年薪約{a}。約有20萬越南人在日本當技能實習生，是人數最多的群體。中介費平均約8,000美元，常常要借錢，雖然法定上限是3,600美元。

events.src: Typhoon Yagi (Sep 2024): about $3.3bn of economic losses, 136,705 homes damaged and over 202,000 ha of rice flooded (Vietnamese officials, via ARY and RFA). The chance that a flood or storm reaches you comes from EM-DAT (people affected a year, 2000–2024: js/data.js); premiums, damage and preparation costs are ESTIMATES.

en..x: Typhoon Yagi in September 2024 damaged 136,705 homes and caused about $3.3 billion of losses. Your area is often hit by storms and floods.

zh..x: 2024年9月的台风“摩羯”（Yagi）毁损了136,705间房屋，经济损失约33亿美元。你住的地区常被台风和洪水侵袭。

zht..x: 2024年9月的颱風「摩羯」（Yagi）毀損了136,705間房屋，經濟損失約33億美元。你住的地區常被颱風和洪水侵襲。

events.src: One-time social insurance withdrawal: 1.5 months' average pay per year before 2014 and 2 months per year from 2014; from 1 July 2025 (Law 41/2024) a pension needs only 15 years and new members can no longer take a lump sum (BHXH; baohiemxahoidientu.vn). The cut to the state pension (5% per year taken out) is an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: cash += a; penM = (penM || 1) * (1 - .05 * n); penTk = 'vn_bhxh'; T('vn_bhxh', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.vn_bhxh'), v: a, note: M('note.got', { a: MN(a) }) })

en..x: You’re changing jobs. You can take your social insurance (BHXH) out as a lump sum, about two months’ pay for each year, or keep the years towards a pension. Since July 2025 a pension needs only 15 years, and new members can no longer take a lump sum.
en..take.s: About {a} now for {n} years of contributions. Your state pension will be smaller.
en..no: You haven’t paid in long enough.

zh..x: 你要换工作了。你可以把社会保险（BHXH）一次性领出来，每缴一年约领两个月工资；也可以保留年资，以后领养老金。从2025年7月起，领养老金只需缴15年，新参保的人不能再一次性领取。
zh..take.s: 缴了{n}年，现在约领{a}。以后的养老金会变少。

zht..x: 你要換工作了。你可以把社會保險（BHXH）一次性領出來，每繳一年約領兩個月薪水；也可以保留年資，以後領退休金。從2025年7月起，領退休金只需繳15年，新參保的人不能再一次性領取。
zht..take.s: 繳了{n}年，現在約領{a}。以後的退休金會變少。

events.src: Gold: SJC gold bars traded 9–20 million dong a tael above the world price in 2024 (VTC News; VnBusiness; Znews), a premium of roughly 10–20%; plain gold rings trade closer to the world price. Deposits pay about 1% above inflation: ESTIMATES.

g.do: pay(a); mkLot('gold', { t: 'gold' }, 'trk.gold'); addLot('gold', f * a); lots.gold.tin += (1 - f) * a; happy += 1

en..x: Vietnamese families have long saved in gold. In 2024 SJC gold bars sold for 9–20 million dong a tael above the world price, a premium you may not get back when you sell; plain gold rings trade closer to the world price.
en..bank.s: Put {a} in at a fixed rate, about 1% a year after inflation.

zh..x: 越南家庭一向用黄金存钱。2024年SJC金条每两比国际金价贵900万到2,000万越南盾，卖出时这部分溢价不一定拿得回来；普通金戒指的价格较接近国际金价。
zh..bank.s: 放入{a}，固定利率，扣除通胀后每年约1%。

zht..x: 越南家庭一向用黃金存錢。2024年SJC金條每兩比國際金價貴900萬到2,000萬越南盾，賣出時這部分溢價不一定拿得回來；普通金戒指的價格較接近國際金價。
zht..bank.s: 放入{a}，固定利率，扣除通膨後每年約1%。

events.src: Household health insurance: 4.5% of the base salary for the first member (Law on Health Insurance, art. 13); the base salary is 2.34 million dong a month from July 2024: about 1.26 million a year ≈ 0.026 of the game's typical wage. Share covered: ESTIMATE.

en..x: Without an employer, your household can buy health insurance (BHYT): 4.5% of the base salary a year for the first member, less for each extra member.
en..join.h: It pays about 55% of your medical bills.

zh..x: 没有雇主时，你家可以买家庭医疗保险（BHYT）：第一个人每年交基本工资的4.5%，之后每多一人更便宜。

zht..x: 沒有僱主時，你家可以買家庭醫療保險（BHYT）：第一個人每年交基本薪水的4.5%，之後每多一人更便宜。

events.src: Moving to Ho Chi Minh City or Hanoi: paper household registration books were abolished from 1 Jan 2023 (Law on Residence 2020). Pay and cost multiples are ESTIMATES.

en..x: A job in Ho Chi Minh City or Hanoi pays about {a} a year. Paper household registration books were abolished in 2023, so moving is easier, but rent is higher and family is far away.
en..go.s: Pay {a} a year. Costs about 30% higher. Happiness −1.

zh..x: 胡志明市或河内的一份工作年薪约{a}。纸本户口簿在2023年取消了，搬家比较容易，但房租较高，家人也远了。

zht..x: 胡志明市或河內的一份工作年薪約{a}。紙本戶口簿在2023年取消了，搬家比較容易，但房租較高，家人也遠了。

events.src: Extra classes: Circular 29/2024 (from 14 Feb 2025) regulates extra classes; those held in school are free and limited to listed groups, and paid classes outside school must be registered businesses (MOET, via Lao Cai and Nong nghiep newspapers). Fees and outcomes are ESTIMATES.

go.do: if (a) { T('vn_hocthem', { kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.tuition') }); rec('vn_hocthem', a, 5); } kidWin(p, .75)

en..x: Many children take extra classes after school. Since February 2025 the rules are stricter: classes in school are free and only for some pupils, and paid classes outside school must be registered businesses.
en..many.s: About {a} a year for 5 years. Busy evenings: Happiness −1.
en..many.h: A better chance of a scholarship later.
en..some.h: Some chance of a scholarship later.
en..none.h: A small chance of a scholarship later.

zh..x: 很多孩子放学后去补习。从2025年2月起规定更严格：校内补习免费且只给部分学生，校外收费补习必须登记为企业。
zh..many.s: 每年约{a}，共5年。晚上很忙：幸福感 −1。
zh..many.h: 以后拿奖学金的机会较大。
zh..some.h: 以后有一些机会拿奖学金。
zh..none.h: 以后拿奖学金的机会较小。

zht..x: 很多孩子放學後去補習。從2025年2月起規定更嚴格：校內補習免費且只給部分學生，校外收費補習必須登記為企業。
zht..many.s: 每年約{a}，共5年。晚上很忙：幸福感 −1。
zht..many.h: 以後拿獎學金的機會較大。
zht..some.h: 以後有一些機會拿獎學金。
zht..none.h: 以後拿獎學金的機會較小。

events.src: Corporate bonds sold at bank counters: in the Van Thinh Phat case, 25 bond issues with no real backing were sold through SCB staff to 35,824 investors, who were owed about 30,000 billion dong (≈ US$1.2 billion) when payments stopped in October 2022 (Ministry of Public Security investigation and 2024 court rulings, via VOH and VietnamFinance); by late 2024 about 8,000 billion had been repaid. Decree 65/2022 then limited private bonds to professional investors. Odds and recovery are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: Your term deposit has matured. The bank clerk suggests a company bond instead: 10% a year, “just like a deposit, only better”.
en..bond.h: A bond is a loan to the company, not a deposit: if the company fails, you may get little back.
en..dep.h: About 1% a year above inflation, and deposits are insured.
en.log.vn_bondBack: The court-ordered repayment for your bond arrives: {a}.

zh..x: 你的定存到期了。银行职员建议你改买一家公司的债券：年息10%，“跟定存一样，只是更好”。
zh..bond.h: 债券是借钱给公司，不是存款：公司倒了，你可能拿不回多少。
zh..dep.h: 扣除通胀后每年大约1%，存款也有保险。
zh.log.vn_bondBack: 法院判决的债券赔偿款到了：{a}。

zht..x: 你的定存到期了。銀行行員建議你改買一家公司的債券：年息10%，「跟定存一樣，只是更好」。
zht..bond.h: 債券是借錢給公司，不是存款：公司倒了，你可能拿不回多少。
zht..dep.h: 扣除通膨後每年大約1%，存款也有保險。
zht.log.vn_bondBack: 法院判決的債券賠償款到了：{a}。

events.src: After the Van Thinh Phat arrests, bondholders waited years for court-ordered repayments; some sold their claims at a deep discount (news reports, 2022–2025). Recovery shares are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: lots.vn_bond.v = 0; lots.vn_bond.tout += .1 * v; cash += .1 * v; happy -= 2

en..x: The company’s chairwoman has been arrested and interest payments have stopped. Your {a} is frozen.
en..wait.h: Happiness −3. Bondholders got back about a third, years later.
en..sell: Sell your claim to a debt buyer

zh..x: 这家公司的董事长被捕了，利息也停发了。你的{a}被冻结。
zh..wait.h: 幸福感 −3。债权人几年后大约拿回三分之一。

zht..x: 這家公司的董事長被捕了，利息也停發了。你的{a}被凍結。
zht..wait.h: 幸福感 −3。債權人幾年後大約拿回三分之一。

events.src: Land fever: in 2021–22 plot prices in many provinces rose about 10% a month, in places doubling or tripling within one or two months, driven by rumours of new roads and planning changes (Vietnam Real Estate Brokers Association; Ministry of Construction, via VietnamNet), before prices and sales fell from late 2022 (CafeF; VNDirect). Sizes and odds are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: Everyone in your village is talking about a new expressway. Plots near the planned exit have doubled in a few months, and a broker says they will double again.
en..buy.h: Prices driven by rumours often fall back.

zh..x: 村里人都在谈新的高速公路。预定出口附近的地几个月就翻了一倍，中介说还会再翻一倍。
zh..buy.h: 靠传言炒起来的价格常常会跌回去。

zht..x: 村裡人都在談新的高速公路。預定出口附近的地幾個月就翻了一倍，仲介說還會再翻一倍。
zht..buy.h: 靠傳言炒起來的價格常常會跌回去。

events.src: After the 2022 cooling, plot prices fell and many buyers could not sell (CafeF; VietnamNet). Sizes are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: lots.vn_land.v = 0; lots.vn_land.tout += .7 * v; cash += .7 * v; happy -= 2

en..x: The expressway exit has moved to another commune. Nobody is buying, and the broker no longer answers his phone.
en..hold.s: Wait for the market to come back.
en..hold.h: The plot is worth about a fifth less for now.
en..sell: Sell for what you can get

zh..x: 高速公路出口改到别的乡了。没人要买，中介也不接电话了。
zh..hold.h: 这块地眼下少值大约两成。

zht..x: 高速公路出口改到別的鄉了。沒人要買，仲介也不接電話了。
zht..hold.h: 這塊地眼下少值大約兩成。

events.src: Insurance sold through banks: a 2023 Ministry of Finance inspection of four life insurers found many violations, including misleading advice; borrowers complained of being pressed to buy life insurance to get loans, and about 70% of policies sold through banks were cancelled after the first year (MoF, via Vietnam News, 2023), losing most of what was paid. The Law on Insurance Business 2022 bars tying insurance to other services. ₫20 million a year ≈ 0.41 of the game’s typical wage; values are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: yearly('vn_life', {amt: .41 * base, until: age + 15}, {rate: 0, lock: age + 15}, 'trk.vn_life')

en..x: You’re signing for a bank loan. The officer says approval would be “much faster” if you also buy the bank partner’s life insurance.
en..buy.s: About {a} a year for fifteen years.
en..buy.h: Most of the first years’ premiums go on charges; stopping early loses them.
en..refuse: Say no and ask for the loan anyway
en..refuse.h: Banks may not make a loan depend on insurance; the loan goes through.
en.trk.vn_life: A life policy from the bank

zh..x: 你在签银行贷款。行员说，如果顺便买银行合作的寿险，核准会“快很多”。
zh..buy.h: 前几年的保费大多是费用；提早解约就没了。
zh..refuse.h: 银行不能把贷款跟保险绑在一起；贷款照样通过。

zht..x: 你在簽銀行貸款。行員說，如果順便買銀行合作的壽險，核准會「快很多」。
zht..buy.h: 前幾年的保費大多是費用；提早解約就沒了。
zht..refuse.h: 銀行不能把貸款跟保險綁在一起；貸款照樣通過。

events.src: Policies cancelled in the first years return only a small part of premiums paid (insurer surrender value tables; MoF 2023 inspection). The 20% surrender value is an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: lots.vn_life.v = 0; lots.vn_life.tout += .2 * v; cash += .2 * v; stopYearly('vn_life'); happy -= 2

en..x: The loan is paid off, but the insurance premiums go on. You have paid in {a}; cancelling now returns only {b}.
en..keep.h: It pays back roughly what you put in, with no growth after inflation.

zh..x: 贷款还清了，保费却还要继续缴。你已经缴了{a}；现在解约只能拿回{b}。
zh..keep.h: 最后大约拿回你缴的钱，扣掉通胀没有增值。

zht..x: 貸款還清了，保費卻還要繼續繳。你已經繳了{a}；現在解約只能拿回{b}。
zht..keep.h: 最後大約拿回你繳的錢，扣掉通膨沒有增值。

events.src: Directive 20/CT-TTg (12 July 2025) told Hanoi to have no petrol or diesel motorbikes inside Ring Road 1 from 1 July 2026 and inside Ring Road 2 from 2028, with other cities to follow (via Tap chi Toa an and Luat Minh Khue). An electric scooter costs about ₫18–25 million, about 0.45 of the game’s typical wage (dealer prices, 2025: ESTIMATE); running-cost savings are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: spend('vn_ev', .45 * base, 'trk.vn_ev'); T('vn_evS', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.vn_evS')}); rec('vn_evS', -.02 * base, 10); happy += 1
cash += .2 * base; T('vn_bus', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.vn_bus')}); rec('vn_bus', -.01 * base, 10, .2); happy -= 1

en..x: The city is banning petrol motorbikes from the centre, where you work. The ban will spread outwards over the next few years.
en..bus: Sell the bike and take the metro and buses
en..bus.h: Happiness −1 at first; a little more walking and less spending.
en..keep: Keep the old bike and park outside the zone

zh..x: 城市要禁止汽油摩托车进入市中心，而你就在那里上班。往后几年禁区还会往外扩大。
zh..bus: 卖掉摩托车，改搭地铁和公交
zh..bus.h: 一开始幸福感 −1；多走点路，也少花点钱。

zht..x: 城市要禁止汽油機車進入市中心，而你就在那裡上班。往後幾年禁區還會往外擴大。
zht..bus: 賣掉機車，改搭捷運和公車
zht..bus.h: 一開始幸福感 −1；多走點路，也少花點錢。

events.src: Voluntary social insurance: you pay 22% of an income you choose; from 1 July 2025 the state pays 20% of the contribution on the rural poverty line for most people (more for poor and near-poor households) for up to 10 years, and a pension needs 15 years of contributions (Law on Social Insurance 2024; Decree 159/2025, via Bao Lao Cai and Lsvn). Contributions on ₫3 million a month ≈ ₫7.9 million a year ≈ 0.16 of the game’s typical wage. The pension it pays is an ESTIMATE.

en..x: Working for yourself, you have no pension. You could join voluntary social insurance: 22% of an income you choose, with a small state top-up.
en..join.s: About {a} a year for twenty years.
en..join.h: A monthly pension for life from retirement age.

zh..x: 自己做生意没有退休金。你可以参加自愿社会保险：按你自选收入的22%缴费，国家还补贴一点。
zh..join: 参加，以每月三百万越南盾为基数
zh..join.h: 到退休年龄起每月领退休金，领到终老。

zht..x: 自己做生意沒有退休金。你可以參加自願社會保險：按你自選收入的22%繳費，國家還補貼一點。
zht..join: 參加，以每月三百萬越南盾為基數
zht..join.h: 到退休年齡起每月領退休金，領到終老。

events.src: Wedding envelopes: guests at Vietnamese weddings give cash (tiền mừng), often ₫500,000–1,000,000 each in cities, which pays back much of the feast (news reports, 2024–25). Feast costs, guest numbers and how much comes back are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: pay(2 * base); const g = (roll('vn_wedding') < .5 ? 1.8 : 1.4) * base; cash += g; const tq = T('vn_wed', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.vn_wed')}); tq.v += g - 2 * base; happy += 2
pay(.8 * base); cash += .65 * base; const tq = T('vn_wed', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.vn_wed')}); tq.v += -.15 * base; happy += 1
pay(.2 * base); cash += .1 * base; const tq = T('vn_wed', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.vn_wed')}); tq.v += -.1 * base

en..x: You and your partner are planning to marry. Your parents have a list of three hundred guests, and every guest will bring an envelope.
en..big.s: About {a} for the feast; the envelopes pay much of it back.
en..big.h: Happiness +2; the families are proud. Envelopes cover 70–90%.
en..mid.s: About {a} for the feast; envelopes pay much of it back.
en..small.h: Fewer envelopes, and some relatives feel left out.

zh..x: 你和伴侣准备结婚了。爸妈列了三百个宾客，每个人都会包红包。
zh..big.s: 喜宴大约{a}；红包能收回一大部分。
zh..big.h: 幸福感 +2；两家都有面子。红包能抵七到九成。
zh..mid.s: 喜宴大约{a}；红包能收回一大部分。
zh..small.h: 红包少了，有些亲戚觉得被冷落。
zh.trk.vn_wed: 扣掉红包后的婚礼开销

zht..x: 你和伴侶準備結婚了。爸媽列了三百個賓客，每個人都會包紅包。
zht..big.s: 喜宴大約{a}；紅包能收回一大部分。
zht..big.h: 幸福感 +2；兩家都有面子。紅包能抵七到九成。
zht..mid.s: 喜宴大約{a}；紅包能收回一大部分。
zht..small.h: 紅包少了，有些親戚覺得被冷落。
zht.trk.vn_wed: 扣掉紅包後的婚禮開銷

events.src: “Light work, high pay” (việc nhẹ lương cao): Vietnam’s border guards and police have brought back thousands of citizens lured by such offers to online-scam compounds in Cambodia, e.g. 362 in five handovers by February 2025 and hundreds more later in the year (via Tuoi Tre, Dan Tri and VNA); families are often asked to pay for their release. Amounts are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: Someone on Facebook offers you a job in Cambodia: typing at a computer for $1,500 a month, flight paid, no experience needed.
en..go.s: They will meet you at the border.
en..go.h: Offers like this are a common trap: people are held and made to run online scams.
en..no.s: It sounds too good to be true.

zh..x: 有人在脸书上找你去柬埔寨工作：坐在电脑前打字，月薪1,500美元，包机票，不需要经验。
zh..go.h: 这种工作常常是陷阱：人会被扣留，被迫做网络诈骗。

zht..x: 有人在臉書上找你去柬埔寨工作：坐在電腦前打字，月薪1,500美元，包機票，不需要經驗。
zht..go.h: 這種工作常常是陷阱：人會被扣留，被迫做網路詐騙。

events.src: People held in scam compounds have been freed through police and embassy action or after families paid; most return with nothing (Vietnamese police and border guards, 2023–2025). Amounts are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: There was no typing job. Your passport has been taken and you are kept in a guarded building. They say you can leave if your family pays {a}.
en..police: Get word to your family to call the police and the embassy
en..police.h: Happiness −6, Health −2; a lost year of pay, but no money to them.

zh..x: 根本没有打字的工作。你的护照被收走，被关在有人看守的大楼里。他们说家人付{a}才放你走。
zh..police: 设法通知家人去报警、找大使馆
zh..police.h: 幸福感 −6，健康 −2；损失一年收入，但不用付钱给他们。
zh..pay.h: 比较快回家。幸福感 −5，健康 −1。

zht..x: 根本沒有打字的工作。你的護照被收走，被關在有人看守的大樓裡。他們說家人付{a}才放你走。
zht..police: 設法通知家人去報警、找大使館
zht..police.h: 幸福感 −6，健康 −2；損失一年收入，但不用付錢給他們。
zht..pay.h: 比較快回家。幸福感 −5，健康 −1。

events.src: Household businesses: Resolution 68-NQ/TW (May 2025) ended lump-sum tax (thuế khoán) by 2026, so household businesses declare revenue, and those above ₫1 billion a year must issue e-invoices from cash registers from June 2025 (Decree 70/2025). Accounting costs, the tax difference and the odds of an audit are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: The flat yearly tax for small businesses is ending. From now on you must declare your real revenue, with electronic invoices.
en..declare: Declare properly, with an accountant’s help
en..declare.s: About {a} a year for the software and accountant.
en..hide: Keep taking cash and declare less
en..hide.h: About a third of those who under-declare are fined later.
en.log.vn_thueFine: A tax audit finds undeclared revenue: back tax and a fine of {a}.

zh..x: 小商户的定额税要取消了。以后要申报实际营收，还要开电子发票。
zh..hide.h: 少报的人大约三分之一之后会被罚款。
zh.log.vn_thueFine: 税务稽查发现漏报营收：补税加罚款{a}。

zht..x: 小商戶的定額稅要取消了。以後要申報實際營收，還要開電子發票。
zht..hide.h: 少報的人大約三分之一之後會被罰款。
zht.log.vn_thueFine: 稅務稽查發現漏報營收：補稅加罰款{a}。

events.src: Margin trading: about 1.5 million new securities accounts were opened in 2021 as first-time (“F0”) investors piled in (Vietnam Securities Depository), and the VN-Index then fell about 33% in 2022 (HOSE), triggering waves of margin calls. Broker margin rates (about 12–14% a year) and the size of the fall are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: debt += a; cash += a; putIn('vn_mg', 2 * a, {}, 'trk.vn_mg')

en..x: The stock market is booming and your friends are all trading. Your broker offers to lend you as much again as you put in.
en..margin: Invest, and borrow as much again
en..margin.s: {a} of your own and {a} borrowed: {b} in stocks.
en..margin.h: Gains and losses are doubled, and the loan charges interest. A big fall can force you to sell.
en..plain.h: Rises and falls with the market.

zh..x: 股市大涨，朋友都在炒股。券商说可以借你跟本金一样多的钱。
zh..margin.h: 赚赔都会加倍，借款还要付利息。大跌时可能被迫卖出。

zht..x: 股市大漲，朋友都在炒股。券商說可以借你跟本金一樣多的錢。
zht..margin.h: 賺賠都會加倍，借款還要付利息。大跌時可能被迫賣出。

events.src: Margin calls: when prices fall, brokers demand more money or sell the shares (Vietnam securities rules; news reports, 2022). Sizes are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: lots.vn_mg.v = 0; lots.vn_mg.tout += .65 * v; cash += .65 * v; happy -= 3

en..x: The market has fallen by a third. Your broker calls: put in {a} by tomorrow or your shares will be sold.
en..sell.s: What’s left comes back to you.
en..sell.h: Happiness −3; you sell at the bottom and still owe the loan.
en..topup.h: Happiness −2; you keep the shares and wait for a recovery.

zh..x: 股市跌了三分之一。券商打电话来：明天以前补{a}，不然就要卖掉你的股票。
zh..sell.h: 幸福感 −3；在低点卖掉，借款还是要还。
zh..topup.h: 幸福感 −2；保住股票，等市场回升。

zht..x: 股市跌了三分之一。券商打電話來：明天以前補{a}，不然就要賣掉你的股票。
zht..sell.h: 幸福感 −3；在低點賣掉，借款還是要還。
zht..topup.h: 幸福感 −2；保住股票，等市場回升。

events.src: Social housing: Decision 338/QĐ-TTg (April 2023) set a goal of over one million social homes by 2030; they sell at capped prices to lower-income buyers, by lottery when oversubscribed, and cannot be resold for five years (Law on Housing 2023). The price discount, the odds of winning and the loan rate are an ESTIMATE.

opts.ok: liq >= .23 * .65 * P || M('e.home.need', { n: MN(.23 * .65 * P), h: MN(liq) })
opts.do: if (roll('vn_nhaxh') < .35) { buyAt(.65 * P, { val: .8 * P, dp: .2, fee: .03, r: .02, n: 25, lk: 'trk.vn_nhaxh', fixed: true }); happy += 3 } else happy -= 1

en..x: A social housing block near your work is taking applications from people on modest incomes, at about two-thirds of market prices. There are many more applicants than flats.
en..apply.s: If you win, a 20% down payment and a cheap loan.
en..apply.h: About a third of applicants win a flat.

zh..x: 你公司附近有一栋社会住房开放中低收入者申请，价钱大约是市价的三分之二。申请的人比房子多得多。
zh..apply.s: 抽中的话，付两成头期款，还有低利贷款。
zh..apply.h: 大约三分之一的申请人能抽中。

zht..x: 你公司附近有一棟社會住宅開放中低收入者申請，價錢大約是市價的三分之二。申請的人比房子多得多。
zht..apply.s: 抽中的話，付兩成頭期款，還有低利貸款。
zht..apply.h: 大約三分之一的申請人能抽中。
